summary.zh: 为标题、CTA 与落地页撰写并评分初稿
summary.en: Draft and score headlines, CTAs and landing page copy

description.zh: 撰写标题、标语、CTA、落地页、定价页和关于页文案，按页面区块结构成稿，候选标题先评分再定稿。适合从零写落地页，或重写关键转化页面时使用。
description.en: Writes headlines, taglines, CTAs, landing pages, pricing and about pages section by section, scoring candidate headlines before settling on one. Good for a new page or a rewrite of a key one.
